About

A small brokerage with a long view.

We started Gilded Estates because the best work in real estate happens when a few people know a market deeply and give clients their full attention.

How we work

We limit the number of clients we take on at any one time. That keeps our calendar open for the phone call that matters, the last-minute showing, and the careful conversation about price.

Where we work

We serve buyers and sellers across Orange County, San Diego, Los Angeles, San Francisco Bay Area. Each neighborhood has its own rhythm, and we’d rather know a few places well than claim to know them all.

Meet the people

You can read about each of us on the team page, or get in touch to start a conversation.
